review_policy.human_review: all Critical, score disagreement >10, and deterministic 20% sample
review_policy.reruns: one initial run; rerun only failed/Critical/boundary lecture-mode, at most two additional runs; decide by majority and mean

must_exclude: claims supported only by blank pages
exact_formulas: descent update retains the minus sign
required_qualifiers: formula symbols follow the slide definitions
mark ambiguous handwritten formula as formula_unresolved
distinguish visible slide content from hidden overlay text
state whether the mapped output is equivariant or invariant
